slides.slide_title: Introduce r-clusters: br cr dr fr gr pr tr

content_payload.front_text: br  cr  dr  fr  gr  pr  tr

slides.teacher_cue: R-clusters: a consonant followed immediately by r. Seven clusters this lesson. br (bring, brown), cr (crack, crown), dr (drop, drum), fr (frog, from), gr (grip, grow), pr (press, price), tr (trip, tree). Critical for Korean learners: /r/ must be produced correctly in every cluster. No vowel between the two consonants.
slides.expected_response: Students produce all seven r-clusters without vowel insertion and with correct /r/ production.
slides.correction_move: Drill each cluster: br-br-br, cr-cr-cr, dr-dr-dr, fr-fr-fr, gr-gr-gr, pr-pr-pr, tr-tr-tr. Confirm /r/ quality — tongue curled back, no contact — before applying to words.
slides.observation_note: Watch for vowel insertion (buh-ring, tuh-rip) and /l/ substitution for /r/ in clusters. Both are common Korean interference patterns in clusters.

slides.teacher_cue: Say bring — to carry here. br cluster, ng coda. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say bring orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model bring orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for vowel insertion between b and r and /l/ on /r/.

slides.teacher_cue: Say crack — a thin break. cr cluster. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say crack orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model crack orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for cr onset — no vowel insertion, /r/ not /l/.

slides.teacher_cue: Say drop — to fall or let fall. dr cluster. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say drop orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model drop orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for dr onset and short /ɒ/ vowel.

slides.teacher_cue: Say frog — the amphibian. fr cluster. Confirm /f/ not /p/. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say frog orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model frog orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /p/ on /f/ and for fr cluster — no vowel insertion.

slides.teacher_cue: Say green — the colour. gr cluster, ee vowel team. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say green orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model green orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for gr onset and long /iː/ in ee.

slides.teacher_cue: Say price — the cost. pr cluster, i_e CVCe, soft c. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say price orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model price orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for pr onset and soft c = /s/ at the end.

slides.teacher_cue: Say trip — a journey. tr cluster. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say trip orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model trip orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for tr onset — no vowel insertion.
